name: Mu Cassiopeiae
description: A naked-eye star 7.6 parsecs away, 79% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured with the CHARA Array.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 6582: radius in solar radii, from the limb-darkened angular diameter 0.972 +/- 0.009 mas (CHARA) and the Hipparcos parallax, 0.79 +/- 0.009

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 6582: effective temperature in K, from the angular diameter and the bolometric flux, 5264 +/- 32

distance.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 746, 101, HD 6582: the Hipparcos parallax the radius was computed with (van Leeuwen 2007), 132.4 +/- 0.6 mas, inverted

text.card: A naked-eye star 8 parsecs away whose disc the CHARA Array measured: 79% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Its disc spans 0.972 milliarcseconds, which gives 0.79 solar radii and 5,264 K at its surface.
text.locator: Tables 5 and 10, HD 6582: limb-darkened diameter, R, Teff
